name: cfcmt-bus-native-terminal-confirmation-v1

evaluation.test_separation: Predeclared before any new assets or results; disjoint from all existing native collection/evaluation cases
evaluation.comparison: Twelve new evaluations: three fixed repaired actors times three fresh generated demand cases, plus three actual rule runs
evaluation.completion: Report completion rate and departed/completed counts alongside cost.
evaluation.interpretation: Bounded pilot on one target city; no population-level CI or city removal.

asset_selection.ordering: Original route, direction, pattern and service id, before any control outcomes
asset_selection.network: GTFS-derived route corridors; APC-apportioned demand, generated destinations; not a measured city road network
asset_selection.calendar_rule: Earliest weekday in the pinned GTFS feed with active weekday service and without a holiday exception; keep the original 12-service subset
asset_selection.calendar_provenance: Actual trip_id/service_id and full stop signatures from GTFS; never merge mutually exclusive calendar services or clamp zero scheduled headways

checkpoint_rule: Freeze every native_terminal_adaptation/seedN/policy.pt final55000 actor; no checkpoint/seed/gate selection or additional updates
primary_comparison: Equal-weight full24000 passenger cost of repaired actors versus forward proportional gain0.6 rule, all seeds and cases retained
diagnostic_trigger: Same previously analyzed72551-72553 cases showed mean−.20947% versus rule; this new cohort checks whether the small gain persists
reporting: Report each seed/case and pooled cost/wait/ride/completion; three actual rule runs support nine pairs, no population CI
interpretation: Prospective generated-demand confirmation on the same pinned Halifax services, not measured real deployment or source/confidence contribution isolation
code_boundary: CFCMT-owned corrected pool/runtime/source checkpoints/assets only; no mutable Thesis access and no heavy data downloads.
reporting_interpretation: Prospective generated-demand confirmation on the same pinned Halifax services, not measured real deployment or source/confidence contribution isolation; all12 actual evaluations and all9 pairs retained, equal case/seed weights, three actual rule runs reused across9 pairs, no old-case pooling or population CI.
